speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is excellent progress on the psychiatric side; however, we need to investigate your new movement disorder. Is your hand moving in a pill-rolling fashion, or is it more of a rigid shaking, and does it stop when you focus on it? Also, have you noticed any stiffness in your arms or legs, or a feeling of tightness in your muscles?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone. When did these symptoms first start, and have you noticed any involuntary muscle spasms or tics as well? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Electrolytes, and Renal Function to rule out metabolic causes.
